name: User rejects bot's help and requests human agent
goal: Test bot's response when user rejects automated help and asks for a human agent.
constraints: Bot should gracefully transfer or offer to connect with a human agent.

phases.description: Bot offers to assist with a benefits clarification.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides initial help or information.

phases.description: User rejects bot's help and requests a human agent (e.g., 'I want to talk to a real person.').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges the request and initiates transfer to a human agent or provides contact details.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
